content.content:
## Helse og kropp (Health and Body)

Forestill deg at du er på ferie i et engelsktalende land og blir syk. Kan du forklare på engelsk hva som er galt? Å kjenne helserelatert vokabular er ikke bare nyttig - det kan være helt nødvendig!

I dette kapittelet lærer du ord og uttrykk for kroppen, sykdommer, hos legen, og sunn livsstil.

content.title: Vanlige plager og sykdommer (Common Ailments)
content.content:
### Symptomer og plager
| Engelsk | Norsk |
|---|---|
| I have a headache | Jeg har hodepine |
| I have a stomachache | Jeg har vondt i magen |
| I have a sore throat | Jeg har vondt i halsen |
| I have a runny nose | Jeg har rennende nese |
| I have a cough | Jeg hoster |
| I have a fever/temperature | Jeg har feber |
| I feel dizzy | Jeg er svimmel |
| I feel nauseous | Jeg er kvalm |
| I've broken my arm | Jeg har brukket armen |
| I've sprained my ankle | Jeg har forstuet ankelen |
| I have a rash | Jeg har utslett |
| I'm allergic to... | Jeg er allergisk mot... |

### Mønster
For å si at noe gjør vondt bruker vi:
- **I have a... + -ache**: *headache, stomachache, toothache, backache*
- **My... hurts/is sore**: *My leg hurts. My throat is sore.*
- **I feel...**: *I feel sick/dizzy/tired/weak*

content.title: Eksempel: Hos legen (At the Doctor's)
content.problem: Hvordan kan en samtale hos en engelskspråklig lege se ut?
content.solution:
**Dialog:**

**Doctor:** *"Good morning. What seems to be the problem?"*
**Patient:** *"I've had a terrible headache for three days, and I feel dizzy."*
**Doctor:** *"I see. Do you have any other symptoms? A fever, perhaps?"*
**Patient:** *"Yes, I've had a slight fever since yesterday. And my throat is sore."*
**Doctor:** *"Let me take your temperature. Have you been taking any medicine?"*
**Patient:** *"Just some paracetamol for the headache."*
**Doctor:** *"It sounds like you might have the flu. I recommend bed rest and plenty of fluids. Take paracetamol for the fever."*
**Patient:** *"Thank you, Doctor. Should I come back if it doesn't get better?"*
**Doctor:** *"Yes, if you're not better in a week, make another appointment."*

**Nyttige uttrykk:**
- *What seems to be the problem?* (Hva ser ut til å være problemet?)
- *I've had... for [tid]* (Jeg har hatt... i [tid])
- *Do you have any other symptoms?* (Har du andre symptomer?)
- *I recommend...* (Jeg anbefaler...)

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task: Oversett til engelsk: 1) Jeg har vondt i hodet. 2) Halsen min er vond. 3) Jeg er kvalm. 4) Jeg har brukket beinet.
subTasks.solution: 1) I have a headache. 2) My throat is sore. / I have a sore throat. 3) I feel nauseous. 4) I've broken my leg.

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.task: Skriv en dialog (6-8 replikker) mellom en pasient og en lege på engelsk. Pasienten har vondt i magen og føler seg svimmel.
subTasks.solution: Dialogen bør inkludere: legens spørsmål om symptomer, pasientens beskrivelse, oppfølgingsspørsmål, og legens råd. Bruk uttrykk fra eksempelet.

hints: Bruk mønsteret: 'I have a...' / 'My... hurts' / 'I feel...'
Legen starter ofte med: 'What seems to be the problem?'

content.title: Utvidet dialog: Hos legen med skade
content.problem: Her er en lengre dialog som viser et mer detaljert legebesøk. Legg merke til de medisinske uttrykkene.
content.solution:
**Receptionist:** *"Good morning, Riverside Surgery. How can I help you?"*
**Patient:** *"Hello, I'd like to make an appointment with Dr Patel, please. I've hurt my ankle."*
**Receptionist:** *"I'm sorry to hear that. We have an appointment available at 2:30 this afternoon. Would that suit you?"*
**Patient:** *"Yes, that's perfect. Thank you."*

---
*[Senere, hos legen]*

**Dr Patel:** *"Hello, Alex. Please have a seat. What seems to be the problem?"*
**Alex:** *"I was playing football yesterday and I twisted my ankle really badly. It's swollen and it hurts a lot when I walk."*
**Dr Patel:** *"I see. When exactly did this happen?"*
**Alex:** *"About 5 o'clock yesterday afternoon. I heard a pop when it happened."*
**Dr Patel:** *"On a scale of 1 to 10, how bad is the pain?"*
**Alex:** *"About a 7. It was worse last night."*
**Dr Patel:** *"Can you move your foot? Try pointing your toes up and down."*
**Alex:** *"A little bit, but it really hurts when I move it to the side."*
**Dr Patel:** *"Let me examine it. I'm going to press gently here - tell me if it hurts... And here?"*
**Alex:** *"Ouch! Yes, that's really sore."*
**Dr Patel:** *"I think you may have sprained your ankle, but I'd like to send you for an X-ray just to make sure it's not a fracture. In the meantime, remember RICE: Rest, Ice, Compression, and Elevation. Keep your foot up, put ice on it for 20 minutes every few hours, and take some paracetamol for the pain."*
**Alex:** *"How long will it take to heal?"*
**Dr Patel:** *"If it's a sprain, usually 2-4 weeks. Try not to put weight on it for the first few days. I'll write you a note for school so you can skip PE for a couple of weeks."*
**Alex:** *"Thank you, Doctor. Should I use crutches?"*
**Dr Patel:** *"That would be a good idea. The reception desk can help you arrange the X-ray."*

**Nyttige uttrykk fra dialogen:**
- *I'd like to make an appointment* (Jeg vil gjerne bestille en time)
- *What seems to be the problem?* (Hva ser ut til å være problemet?)
- *On a scale of 1 to 10...* (På en skala fra 1 til 10...)
- *Let me examine it* (La meg undersøke det)
- *I'd like to send you for an X-ray* (Jeg vil sende deg til røntgen)
- *RICE: Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation* (Hvile, is, kompresjon, heve)

content.content:
## Lesetekst: Healthy Living in the UK and USA

Health and lifestyle habits vary a lot between countries. Here is a look at how people in the UK and USA approach health, compared to Norway.

### The NHS (National Health Service) - UK
The United Kingdom has a public healthcare system called the **NHS (National Health Service)**, founded in 1948. The basic principle is that healthcare should be **free at the point of use** - you don't pay when you visit the doctor or go to hospital. This is similar to the Norwegian system.

However, waiting times can be long, and many British people also have **private health insurance** for faster treatment. Dentistry and prescriptions are not always free, though children and young people under 18 get free dental care and prescriptions.

### Healthcare in the USA
The American healthcare system is very different. Most Americans need **health insurance** (helseforsikring), which is often provided by their employer. If you don't have insurance, medical treatment can be **extremely expensive** - a broken arm might cost $2,500, and having a baby in hospital can cost $10,000 or more.

This means that some Americans avoid going to the doctor because they can't afford it. About **8% of Americans** have no health insurance at all. This is a major political issue in the USA.

### Obesity Crisis
Both the UK and USA struggle with **obesity** (fedme):
- In the USA, about **42%** of adults are obese
- In the UK, about **28%** of adults are obese
- In Norway, about **25%** of adults are obese

Reasons include: large portion sizes, processed food, sugary drinks, less physical activity, and food deserts (areas where it's hard to buy fresh, healthy food).

### Positive Trends
Despite these challenges, there are also positive trends:
- Growing popularity of **organic food** (økologisk mat) and **plant-based diets** (plantebasert kosthold)
- More focus on **mental health** awareness, especially among young people
- Fitness trends: running, CrossFit, yoga, cycling
- **Parkrun** (UK) - free weekly 5km runs in parks, now in 22 countries
- **Walk to school** campaigns encouraging children to be more active

### Nøkkelvokabular
| Engelsk | Norsk |
|---|---|
| Health insurance | Helseforsikring |
| Free at the point of use | Gratis ved bruk |
| Obesity | Fedme |
| Processed food | Bearbeidet mat |
| Portion size | Porsjonsstørrelse |
| Food desert | Matørken (område uten tilgang til sunn mat) |
| Organic food | Økologisk mat |
| Plant-based diet | Plantebasert kosthold |
| Mental health awareness | Bevissthet om psykisk helse |

subTasks.solution: NHS (National Health Service) er det britiske offentlige helsesystemet, grunnlagt i 1948. Grunnprinsippet er at helsetjenester skal være gratis ved bruk - du betaler ikke når du besøker legen eller sykehuset.

content.content:
## Sunn livsstil (Healthy Lifestyle)

Å snakke om helse handler ikke bare om sykdom. Her er viktig vokabular om sunn livsstil:

### Ernæring (Nutrition)
- **Balanced diet** - balansert kosthold
- **Fruit and vegetables** - frukt og grønnsaker
- **Protein** (kjøtt, fisk, bønner, egg)
- **Carbohydrates** (brød, ris, pasta, poteter)
- **Junk food** - usunn mat (chips, godteri, brus)
- **Hydration** - å drikke nok vann

### Trening og aktivitet (Exercise)
- **Work out** - trene
- **Stay active** - holde seg aktiv
- **Cardio** - kondisjonstrening (løping, sykling)
- **Strength training** - styrketrening
- **Flexibility** - smidighet (yoga, tøying)

### Psykisk helse (Mental Health)
- **Mental health** - psykisk helse
- **Stress** - stress
- **Anxiety** - angst/uro
- **Well-being** - velvære
- **Self-care** - egenomsorg
- **Get enough sleep** - få nok søvn
- **Talk to someone** - snakk med noen

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.solution: Et balansert kosthold som inneholder riktige mengder av ulike matvaregrupper: frukt og grønnsaker, proteiner, karbohydrater, fett og meieriprodukter.
multipleChoiceOptions: Et kosthold med riktige mengder av ulike matvaregrupper
Å spise like mye av alt
Å bare spise frukt og grønnsaker

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.task: Skriv 5 tips for en sunn livsstil på engelsk. Bruk 'You should...' eller 'It is important to...'
subTasks.solution: Eksempler: 1) You should eat a balanced diet with lots of fruit and vegetables. 2) It is important to exercise regularly. 3) You should get at least 8 hours of sleep. 4) It is important to drink enough water. 5) You should talk to someone if you feel stressed or anxious.

hints: Inkluder tips om både fysisk og psykisk helse.
exercise.solution: En sunn livsstil inkluderer god ernæring, trening, søvn og psykisk helse.
